known_gap_note: COMCIFS spelling: the file's version line is '#\#CIF_2.0' (escaped-hash form of the COMCIFS reference implementation); CifDialect::detect recognizes only the IUCr '##CIF_2.0' spelling, so the file is parsed as CIF 1.1.
